Plant Material

                                                    ^ Juniper proposed Substitute as Lanceleaf Coreopsis, 1G

                                             ^ Juniper proposed Substitute as Narrowleaf Blue-Eyed Grass, 1G

Landscape Materials
The following Landscape Materials are proposed as specified:
  Mulch proposed as Organic Brown Mulch 
  Organic Fertilizer 16-2-8 proposed 6 Lb / 1,000 SqFt
  Mycorrhizal Fungi Inoculum Fertilizer
  Diehard Transplant Fertilizer 
  Agriform Fertilizer Tablets 
  Poly Plastic Landscape Edging, 1" x 4" Depth
  Weed Barrier installed in plant beds prior to mulching
  Root Barrier Panels for Tree within 10' of Curb
  ArborBrace Tree & Palm Staking included

Soil Samples & Soil Analysis
  Soil Sampling and Soil Testing Analysis included as specified to determine existing soil conditions
  and necessary amendments

Topsoil Application 
    4" Topsoil Import Mix installed throughout Plant Beds and Tree Rings

1-Year Maintenance (Excluded)
Maintenance proposed for 1-Year, post-installation of Plant Material

rows.ProposalDescription1:
This proposal is based on plans prepared by: Stantec, sheets L0000 thru LP604, Dated: May 03, 2024.


LANDSCAPE NOTES: This proposal reflects the plant schedule quantities shown on the plans. Shortages and undersized plant material are common in the landscaping industry due to current market conditions; therefore, height of shrubs per required container size cannot be guaranteed. This proposal may include increased container sizes to meet the requested specifications shown on the plant schedule. An add/deduct price can be provided for an additional cost. Multi-trunk Palm CT/GW/HT measurement based on the shortest truck. Mulch shall be Cocoa Brown. This proposal does not include tree protection, or soil remediation.

Landscape on Tower One bid included a portion of the islands in this bid. 

Material Availability; Silver Buttonwood 45 Gal. - Limited Availability,Sea Grape 45 Gal. 2" CAL - Available up to 1.75" Cal, Purple Glory Tree 65 Gal. 2.5" CAL - Limited Availability, Christmas Palm Field Grown 14.0` OA - Limited Availability, Pigmy Date Palm Multi-Trunk B & B 6.0` CT - Limited Availability, Solitaire Palm B & B 14.0` CT - Limited Availability, Red Tip' Cocoplum 3 gal 36" HT - Available up to 16", Horizontal' Cocoplum 3 Gal. 24" HT - Available up to 12-14", Green Buttonwood 3 Gal. 24" HT - Available up to 18-20", Sea Grape 3 Gal. 24" HT - Available up to 14", Green Island Ficus 3 Gal. 18" HT - Available up to 12", Dwarf Yaupon Holly 3 Gal. 18" HT - Available up to 10-12", Wild Coffee 3 Gal. 24" HT - Available up to 16", Arboricola Trinette 3 Gal. 18" HT - Available up to 14-16", Asian Jasmine 1 Gal 12" HT - Available up to 6", Purple Queen 1 Gal 12" HT - Available up to 6"



SOD NOTES: Sod shall be Floratam per the schedule. Sod quantities are estimated. The actual quantity used may be different. The contractor may request additional areas for sod to be installed at the same square foot price contracted through this scope of work.  A color-out attachment has been provided to show sod areas Juniper has included in this proposal.


IRRIGATION NOTES: Irrigation estimate is based on the plans prepared by Stantec, sheets LI-100 thru LI-103 / LI-501 thru LI-502, Dated: May 03 , 2024. Multiple water sources performance not available at time of estimate. Design and estimate is based on the multiple water sources providing 83 GPM @ 65 PSI. Any deviation from this may result in design and/or price changes. Juniper Landscaping shall not be liable for these multiple POC's ability to produce the volume of water required and/or the quality of water.. Existing POC's must be with 10' from plans location. Power to irrigation controller to be provided by others.. Multiple POC's have no notation pertaining to control wires availability that isn't in controllers wire path. If addition control wires need to be installed there will be a price change. Controller specified has been discontinued quoted its replacement. Juniper standard require gasket mainline pipe with ductile iron fittings & restraint at all change of flow direction. Specifications call for sch 40 pipe which was used in this estimate with ductile iron fittings with restraint at all change of flow direction. Juniper standard require pressure regulated bubblers.  Landscape is irrigated with hydro-zoned. Trees are on separate bubbler zones. All turf is irrigated with rotary heads and standard rotor heads.
